messages:
Maya (Support): heads up — Elaine from @AcroCorp says their month-end invoice total is ~12k tokens higher than the dashboard. invoice id INV-2026-03-ACRO. Elaine: I can share screenshots.
Elaine (Customer): confirmed — dashboard shows 1,120,450 tokens for March, invoice line shows 1,132,980 tokens. plan tier still listed as Pro in the invoice but the account has been on Business since 3/10.
Maya (Support): thx. can you paste the invoice line items and the dashboard CSV export? also account id and any plan change timestamps.
Elaine (Customer): acct_acro_003, plan switch at 2026-03-10T15:02:00Z (via billing portal). attaching screenshot and export link: https://drive.re/redacted
Priya (Billing): looking. initial thought: plan tier mismatch could cause different per-token rates but doesn't change raw token counts — invoice token count discrepancy suggests metering difference.
Jon (Eng): quick checks: did the dashboard aggregation run include or exclude background embed jobs? there was a backfill on 3/09 that reprocessed embeddings for older docs.
Maya (Support): timeline: dashboard export shows last_updated 2026-03-31T23:59:30Z. invoice generation job (BillingBot) ran 2026-04-01T01:00:12Z per BillingBot.
BillingBot: invoice_run INV-2026-03-ACRO completed; lines: 3; total_tokens: 1132980; tier_snapshot: Pro->Business change recorded at 2026-03-10T15:02:01Z.
Sam (Finance): interesting that billing bot logged tier change but line still labeled Pro. could be a snapshot ordering issue. Jon — any chance the meterer counted reprocessed tokens after the dashboard snapshot?
Jon (Eng): possible. we had a delayed embedding job that re-emitted usage events on 2026-03-11 due to a retry loop. two quick diagnostics:
```
-- SQL: count tokens emitted by usage_events for acct_acro_003 in march
select sum(tokens) from usage_events where account_id='acct_acro_003' and ts >= '2026-03-01' and ts < '2026-04-01';
```
I already ran a rough query: usage_events sum = 1,132,972 (close to invoice). dashboard consumption pipeline aggregate = 1,120,450.
Priya (Billing): that matches invoice. dashboard seems to have excluded the reprocessed events (they landed with a retroactive ts but were filtered by the dashboard dedupe heuristics). billing meterer is event-sourced and counts all emitted usage events unless flagged.
Maya (Support): so root cause: reprocessed embed job created duplicate/retro events that billing counted but dashboard deduped. next steps?
Priya (Billing): options: 1) issue a credit for the duplicated tokens (preferred for customer experience), 2) adjust billing pipeline de-dupe to match dashboard heuristics for retro events (risky mid-month), 3) ask AcroCorp to accept invoice as-is (not ideal).
Sam (Finance): we need a precise reconciliation CSV to compute credit: compute intersection set of event_ids that billing saw but dashboard suppressed. Jon — can you export event ids and mark duplicates?
Jon (Eng): will do. quick snippet to extract suspect events:
```
select event_id, ts, tokens, origin from usage_events where account_id='acct_acro_003' and ts >= '2026-03-09' and ts < '2026-03-12' order by ts;
```
I'll annotate which were replays (origin='emb_backfill' and replay_flag=1).
Elaine (Customer): appreciate the fast triage. if you can credit the duplicates that would be great — we budgeted for Business plan tokens.
Maya (Support): assigning: Jon to produce reconciliation CSV by EOD PST, Priya to propose credit amount and ledger entry, Sam to approve. I'll keep Elaine updated.
Priya (Billing): note for audit: we need changelog for plan snapshot ordering. billing service stored snapshot_at for plan at 2026-03-10T15:02:01Z but invoice line label used the snapshot prior to change. logging ticket filed: BLG-5589.
Jon (Eng): exported CSV: https://internal-storage/redacted/acro_recon_2790011223.csv — contains event_id, ts, tokens, origin, replay_flag. found 12,528 extra tokens with origin='emb_backfill' and replay_flag=1.
Sam (Finance): confirmed numbers. Priya — draft credit memo for 12,528 tokens at $0.0008/token => $10.02 (rounded). Approving credit.
Priya (Billing): credit memo prepared and queued. invoice will be amended; ledger will reflect negative line with reason "duplicate embed replays". I'll copy back the journal id when posted.
Elaine (Customer): thank you! much appreciated. :relieved:
Maya (Support): closing loop: followups — engineering to patch replay detection in billing ingestion (Jon), billing to ensure invoice snapshot labels align with snapshot times (Priya), finance to post credit (Sam). I'll update the ticket and set status to pending-credit. :eyes:
DevOps: FYI — I'll add monitoring alert for backfill replay volumes so we catch similar spikes next month.
Maya (Support): marking thread resolved for now once credit posts. will reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
